intro: Peru has about 34 million people, with a large Indigenous population.

chapters.title: People
text: Spanish, Quechua and Aymara are official. Many Peruvians are of Indigenous or mixed descent. Most people are Catholic, often mixed with Andean traditions.

chapters.title: Lima
text: Lima, the capital, holds about a third of all Peruvians.

keyTerms.meaning: The language of the Inca, still spoken by millions.
